business_summary: Zhejiang Founder Motor Co., Ltd. provides micro-motors and controllers in China and internationally. It operates through Drive Motors and Automotive Electronics, Intelligent Controllers, and Micro Motors segments. It also researches, develops, produces, and sells sewing machines; automobile seating motors; automotive electronics; household appliance; and automotive application products, including new energy vehicle drive motors, supporting motors, and powertrain controls. The company also involved in the Electric motor manufacturing; research and development of electric motors and control systems; manufacturing and sales of generators and generator sets; manufacturing of household sewing machine motors, industrial automatic sewing machines, servo control systems, and auxiliary automotive motors; production and sales of motors and components for power tools, household appliances, and household sewing machines; sales of new energy vehicle production/testing equipment, battery swapping facilities, and electrical accessories; production and development of computer software; development and sales of electronic and automotive electronic products; manufacturing of ECU controllers, gas system modules, AMT actuator modules, communication modules, and other electronic products; domestic trade and material supply; economic information consulting; import and export of goods and technology; and house leasing. It serves NEV, sewing machinery, automotive seat motor, automotive electronics, household appliances, robotic joints and low-altitude economy sectors. The company was formerly known as Lishui Fangzheng Motor Manufacturing Co., Ltd. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Lishui, China.
